item.description: A gem imbued with natural Earth chakra. It increase Earth damage done.

item.description: A sword with special markings on it that seem to make the sword react when used in conjunction with chakra elements.

item.name: Chakra Disrupting Needles
item.description: You throw specially prepared needles that drain your target's vitality and cause their attacks to recoil against them.

item.description: A small pill radiating with energy. Its hard for any one person to metabolize the abundance of energy.
item.battleDescription: %user quickly crushes the small ball in their mouth releasing a burst of flavor and energy through their body. They seem to glow with vigor.

jutsu.name: Stormsinger
jutsu.description: A powerful stormy chakra surrounds the user.
jutsu.battleDescription: Calling upon the divine power of Susanoo, %user becomes one with the storm, their presence merging with the crackling energy in the air.

jutsu.name: Sounds of Tempest
jutsu.description: This jutsu channels lightning chakra through the target causing their very blood to become toxic to them.
jutsu.battleDescription: As the tempest rages, %user's eyes begin to glow with a dark blue radiance, mirroring the eye of the storm growing within, intensifying the ferocity and might of the unleashed power. %user then melds the forces of lightning and water, birthing "Akuma no Arashi", a cataclysmic storm of unparalleled power. The merging elements surge forth, enveloping %target and battlefield, a single bolt of lightning strikes them.

jutsu.name: Demons Strike
jutsu.description: Call down a powerful storm strike on an area while raising a temporary shield around yourself.
jutsu.battleDescription: as the storm rages on,  %user calls upon the power of the storm, forming a fearsome lightning strike from within the clouds. The demonic lightning descends with tremendous speed and force, crashing into %target with overwhelming power.

jutsu.name: Opening Strike
jutsu.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user strikes %target, leaving an opening for further attacks.

jutsu.description: A powerful stormy chakra surrounds the user.

jutsu.description: This jutsu channels lightning chakra through the target causing their very blood to become toxic to them.
jutsu.battleDescription: As the tempest rages, %user's eyes begin to glow with a dark blue radiance, mirroring the eye of the storm growing within, intensifying the ferocity and might of the unleashed power. %user then melds the forces of lightning and water, birthing "Akuma no Arashi", a cataclysmic storm of unparalleled power. The merging elements surge forth, enveloping %target and battlefield, a single bolt of lightning strikes them.
